metadata.pricing scope: PTU sizing/lifecycle reviewed 2026-10-28; token prices carry model-specific scope. Existing Azure OpenAI rates retained; new verified rates use East US 2 retail meters. Retired/unverified comparisons are unavailable. PTU commitment prices are planning assumptions.
notes: Token prices are USD per 1,000 tokens. Null means unverified, never free.
PTU model set and sizing follow the Microsoft Learn main sizing guide and linked Fireworks PTU table, reviewed 2026-10-28.
Removed unlisted native Gemini 1.5 and MiniMax M2.5 entries. Removed retired PayGO-only DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731; FW-DeepSeek-V4-Flash is a separate PTU identity, not an alias.
PayGO-only GLM 5.2 Fast and GLM 5.3 Flash are excluded from this PTU calculator because the reviewed table provides no PTU configuration.
Existing Fireworks automatic output weights remain explicit estimates. New Fireworks models require benchmarked capacity because output weights are not published.
The user-requested GPT-5.4-mini 8:1 output weight overrides the guide's 6:1.
PTU prices remain USD 260/month or USD 221/month annual equivalent planning assumptions, not verified current model-specific reservation quotes.
PayGO retirement does not retire PTU. Retired PayGO rates, if retained, are historical and excluded from comparisons.
Azure prices vary by geography, deployment type, agreement, and currency. Browser-saved custom catalogs are preserved; restore the bundled catalog to adopt this refresh.
